peg_reference.notes: CADC targets 1 CADC to 1 Canadian dollar. Direct issuer minting and redemption require Loon signup and verification, while wallet holding and transfer are permissionless.

classification_notes: Active Canadian-dollar stablecoin with current 1:1 reserve backing, monthly attestation, direct verified-user redemption, and five-network availability.

peg_reference.notes: ZARP targets one South African rand per token. Direct issuance and redemption are restricted to approved ZARP Partners.

classification_notes: Active South African rand stablecoin with 1:1 reserve backing, current transparency and attestation context, and approved-partner mint and redeem access on four officially supported native networks.
